_how: Cedar's brain (Mr. Marquez), read by /backstage/brain/mind.js. You type anything and he answers in the dialogue box. TOPICS: 'match' is a list of phrases; a phrase matches if all of its words are somewhere in what was typed, and the longest matching phrase wins. 'replies' are said one at random; 'again' is used most of the time once that topic has come up before. A reply is one line, a list of lines (several text boxes), or {"say": [lines], ...conditions}. Lines use dialogue.json's format: plain text or {"text": "..", "face": "smile|angry|point", "speed": 50}, with [red] [yellow] [blue] [gray] [gold] [shake] [wave] markup, ^1-^9 pauses, and (parentheses) for narration. {"go": "nodeId"} jumps into dialogue.json instead (his hand-written conversations). CONDITIONS on a reply or a whole topic: has / had / lost / never (items), flag ("!flag" = not set; marquez_cedar, wonder_unlocked, todd_dead...), seen / unseen (a dialogue node or mark he's said), known (true once you know his name is Cedar), named (true once he knows your name), after (only right after that node or topic, for answering his questions). 'short': true = only counts for 3 words or fewer. 'do': 'show' opens the drawer, 'craft' opens the workbench, 'tell' asks for a code. 'end': true says the lines and then he's done talking. PLACEHOLDERS: {name} your name, {kills} little ones deleted, {item} the thing you named, {1} the part of what you said a reflect pattern caught. CODES: anything in dialogue.json 'finds' typed on its own works as it always did; codes in 'loose' also work inside a sentence; 'chatWords' are codes that are also everyday words, so his brain answers them first. ITEMS: the names that count as each thing in your drawer. SILENT: menu nodes he skips in free typing. ENDS: nodes that finish the conversation. SAY: his lines for show-and-tell and the workbench.
_note: Drafted by Claude from Cedar's own dialogue.json and the lore so far; rewrite freely. Things the story hasn't answered yet (who Big Papa is, who cancelled Varandia, what Wonder was god of, what glows in his pocket) he dodges on purpose.
